prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Close-up. Hands seen from behind raised flat against the wet black planks of a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, rising out of the water, rain running down the planks. Rain, grey light on the pitch. Desperate and too late. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
